instruction: Check a Consul intention between two services
output:
consul intention check web db
Denied

(Consul intention denies web -> db)

instruction: Create an allow Consul intention
output:
consul intention create web db
Created intention: web => db (allow)

instruction: Create a deny Consul intention with a custom description
output:
consul intention create -deny -description "Block access from staging" staging api
Created intention: staging => api (deny)

instruction: List all Consul intentions
output:
consul intention list
ID                                    SourceName      DestinationName  Action  Description
e4f5a6b7-c8d9-0123-4567-890abcdef012  web             db               allow   
f5a6b7c8-d9e0-1234-5678-90abcdef0123  staging         api              deny    Block access from staging
a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890  frontend        backend          allow

instruction: Update an existing Consul intention to change action
output:
consul intention create -replace -description "Allow after fix" web db
Created intention: web => db (allow)

instruction: Delete a Consul intention by ID
output:
consul intention delete a1b2c3d4-e5f6-7890-abcd-ef1234567890
Intention deleted successfully

instruction: Delete all Consul intentions matching a source
output:
consul intention delete -source web
Deleted 3 intentions matching source: web

instruction: Register a Consul service on the command line
output:
consul services register '{"ID":"api-1","Name":"api","Address":"10.0.0.10","Port":8080}'
Successfully registered service: api-1

instruction: Deregister a Consul service by ID
output:
consul services deregister -id=api-1
Successfully deregistered service: api-1

instruction: Deregister all Consul services matching a name
output:
consul services deregister -name=web
Successfully deregistered 2 service(s) with name: web

instruction: Force a Consul node to leave the cluster (non-graceful)
output:
consul force-leave node3
Successfully forced node3 to leave
